hooks.command: [ -n "$T3CODE_HOME" ] || exit 0; printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"This session runs inside T3 Code. Load the t3c skill with the Skill tool before your first other action, and follow it for the rest of the session."}}'

jq -e '.agent_type == "claude-code-guide"' >/dev/null && exit 0; printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"WebSearch is disabled. Use the parallel skill for web search and research."}}'

jq -e '.agent_type == "claude-code-guide"' >/dev/null && exit 0; printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"WebFetch is disabled. Use the firecrawl skill to fetch, scrape, or crawl URLs."}}'

jq -e '.tool_input.run_in_background != true and ((.tool_input.command // "") | test("^\\s*sleep(\\s|$)"))' >/dev/null || exit 0; printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"A Bash command that starts with sleep is never moved to the background: it blocks the session and is stopped at the Bash timeout, so nothing after the sleep runs. To wait for a condition, use the Monitor tool if you have it; otherwise run Bash with run_in_background: true and a loop that exits when the condition holds, for example: until <check>; do sleep 5; done. Background results arrive on their own; do not poll them."}}'

[ -n "$T3CODE_HOME" ] || exit 0; jq -e '.tool_input.run_in_background == true' >/dev/null || exit 0; printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"T3 Code counts a background Bash command as a long-lived command such as a dev server, so the thread leaves the user'\''s Working list while it runs. If you are waiting on this result, use the Monitor tool for the wait instead, with a command that exits once the condition holds, such as an until-loop, never tail -f, because a running Monitor keeps the thread in Working; to wait on a pull request, use the T3 watch_pull_request tool and call unwatch_pull_request before handing back. Leave servers and other long-lived processes as background Bash."}}'

jq -e '(.tool_input.skill // .tool_input.subagent_type // "") | test("^(update-config|claude-api|keybindings-help|claude-code-guide)$")' >/dev/null || exit 0; printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"Built-in Claude Code and Claude API guidance can lag the installed release.
